title: One word, one home
sub: Film 3 of 10 of a series on data governance: five glossaries define the same word three ways, and the university keeps one that everyone trusts, with every tool reading from it.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. The three meanings of award are violet, rose and olive; gold is governance's decisions, green runs in the work, grey can go.
